```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

# Load Data
```{r rlc_data}
rlc_Deep <- read_xlsx("data/raw_RLCs/2023-03-31_Deep_Mgris_RLCs.xlsx")

rlc_Deep_data <- data.frame(
  par = rlc_Deep$PAR,
  etr = rlc_Deep$ETR,
  id = c(rep("Deep", 7)),
  individual = paste(rlc_Deep$Depth, rlc_Deep$Geno, sep = "_"),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)

rlc_Midd <- read_xlsx("data/raw_RLCs/2023-04-01_Midd_Mgris_RLCs.xlsx")

rlc_Midd_data <- data.frame(
  par = rlc_Midd$PAR,
  etr = rlc_Midd$ETR,
  id = c(rep("Midd", 6)),
  individual = paste(rlc_Midd$Depth, rlc_Midd$Geno, sep = "_"),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)

rlc_Shall <- read_xlsx("data/raw_RLCs/2023-04-05_Shall_Mgris_RLCs.xlsx")

rlc_Shall_data <- data.frame(
  par = rlc_Shall$PAR,
  etr = rlc_Shall$ETR,
  id = c(rep("Shall", 6)),
  individual = paste(rlc_Shall$Depth, rlc_Shall$Geno, sep = "_"),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
```

# Bin PAR values
```{r rlc_data}
# Define target PAR values
target_par <- c(0, 25, 45, 66, 91, 126, 191, 286, 423, 632, 825, 1155, 1506)

# Function to round to nearest target PAR
nearest_par <- function(x, targets) {
  targets[which.min(abs(x - targets))]
}

# Apply to rlc_data
rlc_data <- rbind(rlc_Deep_data, rlc_Midd_data, rlc_Shall_data) %>%
  mutate(par_binned = vapply(par, nearest_par, numeric(1), targets = target_par)) %>%
  dplyr::select(par = par_binned, etr, id, individual)

# Check the result
unique(rlc_data$par)
```

# Fit Population - Level Models
```{r}
#Deep 

# Filter Deep population and order by PAR
deep_df <- rlc_data %>%
  filter(id == "Deep") %>%
  arrange(par)

# Calculate light-level means for starting values
deep_means <- deep_df %>%
  group_by(par) %>%
  summarise(etr_mean = mean(etr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Starting values
deep_ps_start    <- max(deep_means$etr_mean, na.rm = TRUE)  # PGH potential max
deep_alpha_start <- (deep_means$etr_mean[3] - deep_means$etr_mean[2]) / 
                    (deep_means$par[3] - deep_means$par[2])
deep_beta_start  <- 0.0001  # small initial photoinhibition

# Fit PGH 1980 model: etr ~ ps * (1 - exp(-alpha * par / ps)) * exp(-beta * par / ps)
deep_fit <- nlsLM(
  etr ~ ps * (1 - exp(-alpha * par / ps)) * exp(-beta * par / ps),
  data = deep_df,
  start = list(
    ps    = deep_ps_start,
    alpha = deep_alpha_start,
    beta  = deep_beta_start
  ),
  control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 200)
)

# Extract coefficients
deep_coefs <- data.frame(
  ps    = coef(deep_fit)["ps"],
  alpha = coef(deep_fit)["alpha"],
  beta  = coef(deep_fit)["beta"],
  depth = "Deep",
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  # Calculate derived ETRmax (real observed peak) and Ek (saturation irradiance)
  mutate(
    ETRmax = ps * (alpha / (alpha + beta)) * (beta / (alpha + beta))^(beta / alpha),
    Ek     = ETRmax / alpha
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(depth, ps, alpha, beta, ETRmax, Ek)

# Sequence of light intensities for predictions
deep_I <- seq(0, 1506, length.out = 200)

# Predicted ETR across light intensities
deep_pred_df <- tibble(
  par      = deep_I,
  etr_pred = predict(deep_fit, newdata = tibble(par = deep_I))
) %>%
  mutate(depth = "Deep")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Middle
```

# Average ETRs
```{r avg_etr}
avg_etr <- rlc_data %>%
  mutate(light_depth = paste0(par, "_", id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(par, etr, depth = id, Geno = individual, light_depth) %>%
  group_by(light_depth) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_etr = mean(etr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_etr = sd(etr, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_etr = sd_etr / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(par = sub("_.*", "", light_depth)) %>%
  mutate(depth = sub(".*_", "", light_depth)) %>%
  mutate(depth = case_when(depth == "Midd"  ~ "Middle", 
                           depth == "Shall" ~ "Shallow", 
                           TRUE ~ depth))

avg_etr$par <- as.numeric(avg_etr$par)

```

```{r PGH_pop_fits}
PGH_pop_fits <- ggplot(avg_etr, aes(x = par, y = mean_etr, color = depth)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = (mean_etr -se_etr),

# Middle model and Ek

            color = 'dodgerblue3', linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(data = midd_coefs, aes(xintercept = Ek), linetype = "longdash",

  # Shallow model and Ek
  geom_line(data = shall_pred_df, aes(x = par, y = etr_pred),

 geom_vline(data = shall_coefs, aes(xintercept = Ek), linetype = "longdash",
            color = "#6BAED6", linewidth = 0.75,alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkblue', 'dodgerblue3', '#6BAED6')) +

        strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
```

# Check goodness of fit for model
```{r metrics df}

get_residuals <- function(df, fit) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      P_pred = predict(fit, newdata = tibble(par = par)),
      residual = etr - P_pred
    )
}

# Apply for each depth
deep_resid  <- get_residuals(rlc_data %>% filter(id == "Deep"), deep_fit)
midd_resid  <- get_residuals(rlc_data %>% filter(id == "Midd"), midd_fit)
shall_resid <- get_residuals(rlc_data %>% filter(id == "Shall"), shall_fit)

# Combine
residuals_df <- bind_rows(deep_resid, midd_resid, shall_resid)

summary(residuals_df$residual)

# Residual plot
ggplot(residuals_df, aes(x = par, y = residual, color = id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()

fit_metrics <- residuals_df %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(residual^2)),
    relative_RMSE = RMSE / sd(etr), 
    RSS = sum(residual^2),
    TSS = sum((etr - mean(etr))^2),
    R2 = 1 - RSS / TSS)

```

# Fit Colony - Level Models
```{r etr_table}

etr_results <- rlc_data %>%
  dplyr::select(id, par, individual, etr) %>%
  group_by(individual, id) %>%
  arrange(par, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    
    df <- .x
    I <- df$par
    E <- df$etr
    
    # Starting values 
    ps_start <- max(E, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    nonzero_I <- sort(unique(I[I > 0]))
    
    alpha_start <- if(length(nonzero_I) >= 2){
      low  <- nonzero_I[1]
      high <- nonzero_I[2]
      (E[I == high][1] - E[I == low][1]) / (high - low)
    } else {
      1e-4
    }
    
    beta_start <- 0.001  # small photoinhibition
    
    # Fit PGH model 
    fit <- tryCatch({
      nlsLM(
        etr ~ ps * (1 - exp(-alpha * par / ps)) * exp(-beta * par / ps),
        data = df,
        start = list(ps = ps_start, alpha = alpha_start, beta = beta_start),
        lower = c(0, 0, 0),
        control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 200)
      )
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
    
    # Extract coefficients 
    if(!is.null(fit)){
      coefs <- coef(fit)
      
      ps    <- as.numeric(coefs["ps"])
      alpha <- as.numeric(coefs["alpha"])
      beta  <- as.numeric(coefs["beta"])
      
      # TRUE ETRmax (PGH formula)
      ETRmax <- ps * (alpha / (alpha + beta)) *
        (beta / (alpha + beta))^(beta / alpha)
      
      Ek <- ETRmax / alpha
      
      tibble(
        ps = ps,
        alpha = alpha,
        beta = beta,
        ETRmax = ETRmax,
        Ek = Ek
      )
      
    } else {
      tibble(
        ps = NA_real_,
        alpha = NA_real_,
        beta = NA_real_,
        ETRmax = NA_real_,
        Ek = NA_real_
      )
    }
    
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
   

etr_summary <- etr_results %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    ps_mean = mean(ps, na.rm = TRUE),
    ps_se   = sd(ps, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    alpha_mean = mean(alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha_se   = sd(alpha, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    beta_mean = mean(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta_se   = sd(beta, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    Ek_mean = mean(Ek, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ek_se   = sd(Ek, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

etr_table <- etr_summary %>%
  mutate(
    `ETRmax (µmol e⁻ m⁻² s⁻¹)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", ps_mean, ps_se),
    `α` = sprintf("%.4f ± %.4f", alpha_mean, alpha_se),
    `Ek (µmol quanta m⁻² s⁻¹)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", Ek_mean, Ek_se),
    `β` = sprintf("%.4f ± %.4f", beta_mean, beta_se)   # added beta with SE
  ) %>%
  rename(depth = id) %>%
  mutate(depth = case_when(
    depth == "Midd"  ~ "Middle", 
    depth == "Shall" ~ "Shallow", 
    TRUE ~ depth
  )) %>%
  dplyr::select(depth,
                `ETRmax (µmol e⁻ m⁻² s⁻¹)`,
                `α`,
                `β`,                       # include beta column
                `Ek (µmol quanta m⁻² s⁻¹)`,
                n)



etr_table_nice <- nice_table(etr_table)
save_as_docx(etr_table_nice, path = "Plots/Fig_2/Table_1_ETR.docx")
```

# Parameter Stats 
```{r Ek} 
# Shapiro-Wilk Test for Normality
shapiro.test(etr_results$Ek[etr_results$id == "Deep"])
shapiro.test(etr_results$Ek[etr_results$id == "Midd"])
shapiro.test(etr_results$Ek[etr_results$id == "Shall"])

# Levene Test for Homogeneity fo Variances
leveneTest(Ek ~ id, data = etr_results)

# ANOVA
anova_result_ek <- aov(Ek ~ id, data = etr_results)
summary(anova_result_ek)

# Tukey 
TukeyHSD(anova_result_ek)
```

```{r ETRmax}
# Shapiro-Wilk Test for Normality
shapiro.test(etr_results$ETRmax[etr_results$id == "Deep"])
shapiro.test(etr_results$ETRmax[etr_results$id == "Midd"])
shapiro.test(etr_results$ETRmax[etr_results$id == "Shall"])

# Levene Test for Homogeneity fo Variances
leveneTest(ETRmax ~ id, data = etr_results)

# ANOVA
anova_result_ETRmax <- aov(ETRmax ~ id, data = etr_results)
summary(anova_result_ETRmax)

# Tukey 
TukeyHSD(anova_result_ETRmax)
```
